name_zh: 林德伯格-列维中心极限定理
category: probability and stochastic processes / foundations of probability
canonical_claim: For iid real-valued random variables with finite second moment on a probability space, the centered partial sums divided by the square root of n converge in distribution to a centered Gaussian random variable whose variance is the variance of one summand.
